deadlines.title: REAP new rule takes effect
deadlines.note: 25% grant for energy projects, e.g. efficiency or solar on a fixed cooler. Needs 12 months of operation, so Year 2+ at the earliest.

deadlines.title: AFID Infrastructure grant, fall round closes
deadlines.note: Up to $50,000 reimbursement, a fit for the cooler. Applied for by a locality (county, city, EDA or PDC), not the business. Likely missed unless a county is already on board; target spring 2027. VDACS AFID: 804-786-1906.

deadlines.title: Southern SARE Producer Grant due (noon EST)
deadlines.note: Research only ($20k farmer / $25k farmer group), e.g. an on-farm harvest study with a rented unit. Not the business, not equipment.

deadlines.title: Agriculture Innovation Centers (AIC)
deadlines.note: For centers that assist producers, not the business. Indirect: technical help.
